hero.title: Help center
hero.subtitle: Zylo Office is a young product, backed by a small team. You won't find a giant knowledge base here, but honest answers to the most common questions — and a simple way to reach us directly.

start.question: How do I get started with Zylo Office?
start.answer: There is no self-service sign-up yet: our team sets up your organization together with you, step by step. Leave us your details on the "It's free" page and we'll get back to you to arrange a demo and a guided start.

modules.question: Which modules are available?
modules.answer: Two applications today: Zylo Liquid for managing fuel stations, and Zylo Tanker for tracking tanker truck fleets. Details on each are on the Applications page.

contact.question: How do I contact support?
contact.answer: The simplest way is the contact block below: we don't have a dedicated phone line or live chat yet, but we personally reply to every request.

security.question: Is my data secure?
security.answer: Access to Zylo Office is protected by authentication and by fine-grained role and permission management, specific to each organization. We stay transparent: we don't display a certification that doesn't exist yet, and we're happy to share technical details on request.

pricing.question: How much does Zylo Office cost?
pricing.answer: Pricing depends on the modules and activity volume of your business. Check the Pricing page for an overview, or contact us for a quote tailored to your station or fleet.

multiUser.question: Can several people on my team use Zylo Office?
multiUser.answer: Yes. Each organization can invite team members and assign them suitable roles (management, data entry, read-only), configured together with you during setup.

contact.title: Get in touch
contact.body: Have a question we haven't answered here? Write to us directly: our team replies personally, no bot and no queue.
